description: A watercolor painting of fish sits on the table with a white cup of water nearby, along with a paint palette and some small paper scraps. The left hand stays near the scraps while the right hand lifts the paintbrush upward and left toward the cup, dips and swirls the brush tip inside the water to rinse it, then lifts the brush back out toward the workspace; the paintbrush is the right-hand object throughout.
